questions.explanation: Template Context and Custom Rendering is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Template Context and Custom Rendering”?
options: Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
